evidence.note: text node toolbar + Follow Up + composer token

observations.text: Canvas is React Flow (data-testid rf__wrapper, rf__node-<uuid>, React Flow a11y descriptions). Route is /conv/<uuid>; an invisible root node carries the same uuid as the flow.

Node kinds seen: prompt node (text, footer 'Me' + date), answer node (rich markdown, footer = model id e.g. claude-3.5-sonnet / gpt-4o, + date), image node (footer = model e.g. recraft-v3), video-prompt node (kling-text-to-video), comment bubble attached to a node with a count, Follow-up draft prompt node. Edges are dashed parent->child lines; a prompt fans out to several parallel answers (branching tree).

Selecting a node shows the toolbar AND inserts the node into the bottom composer as a removable token ('Focus node ...'). Multiple selections accumulate tokens. Settings names this 'Node Interaction Mode: Quote first'.

Toolbar is type-specific: answer = colour tags · Rerun · Copy Content · Edit(E) · Delete; prompt = colour tags · Copy Content · Delete; image = Crop · Upscale · Background Removal · Vary · Rerun · Copy Content · Download · Delete. All get an Add-node handle and Follow Up (F) = 'Branch node'.

Follow Up on an image node highlighted its six ancestors, switched the composer to Image mode, inserted a 'Follow-up with 6 nodes' token and created a new prompt node ('Me · Just now') that survived reload (33 -> 34 nodes).
Vary opens a mini generation form (batch 1X only on Free; ratio; top-model list with most models locked; cost line '1 Generation with 1:1 ratio in Seedream 5.0 Pro'; Cancel/Run). Not run.
Edit on a text node surfaced 'Upgrade to unlock' - node content editing is gated on Free.
Comment is a mode: 'Move the mouse to the node and click to add comment'; existing threads render as a bubble with a count on the node.
Share dialog: link switch (already on for this tutorial flow), permission 'can view', Copy Link, owner row. Nothing changed.
Search Node is flow-scoped (All 33 / Text 25 / Media 8) with Export; the in-flow Media History dock was empty although the flow contains images.
Zoom (25%) and the new node persisted across a hard reload; assets are Supabase storage URLs.
Media History dock lists generations made in this flow (tutorial images were imported, hence empty); sidebar Media History (/gallery) is account-scoped with a day strip.
'Add node' (+ on node edge) is a React Flow connection handle; clicking it only re-added the composer token.
No node-level right-click menu observed; Upscale menu contents; Organize Nodes effect (not run on the owner's flow); multi-select; drag semantics; Composer semantics.
